en.endings.exhibition.title: The exhibition happened
en.endings.exhibition.body: For the first time in ten years, the Stadium stands were full. Palm Oasis is alive again.
en.endings.deadline.title: Time's up
en.endings.deadline.body: The investors' sixteen weeks are over and the exhibition never happened. The restoration stops and the gates are locked again.
en.endings.bankrupt.title: Out of money
en.endings.bankrupt.body: The garden can't make payroll and the investors stop the restoration. The gates are locked again.
en.events.iw_pickle_noise.title: Too loud, one court short
en.events.iw_pickle_noise.body: Three members who have played here for twenty years are waiting by the pickleball courts. "Pop, pop, pop, all weekend. And we lost a tennis court for it." More of them are talking about La Quinta.
en.events.iw_pickle_noise.options.B: Hold a members' meeting about time slots (you, 3 hours; it may not work)
en.events.iw_investor_check.title: The investors visit
en.events.iw_investor_check.body: The investors are at the main gate. Three weeks are left before their deadline.
en.events.iw_investor_check.options.B: Have a look on your own
en.events.iw_deadline.title: Time's up
en.events.iw_deadline.body: Sixteen weeks are over. The investors leave a folder on the clubhouse desk.
en.events.iw_arrival.title: The ball machine in the shed
en.events.iw_arrival.body: Dale shows you around. "Ten years, and nobody's hit a ball here." There's an old ball machine in the shed.
en.events.iw_arrival.options.A: Keep it and fix it for the academy later
en.events.iw_arrival.options.B: Sell it for some cash now
en.events.iw_first_players.title: The first visitors
en.events.iw_first_players.body: Two retirees from Palm Desert stand at the gate of the members' court and ask if they can play.
en.events.iw_sandstorm.title: The wind is up
en.events.iw_sandstorm.body: Sand is pouring onto the courts. Dale asks over the radio whether to cover them now.
en.events.iw_sandstorm.options.B: Wait for the wind to stop
en.events.iw_reporter.title: The Desert Sun is here
en.events.iw_reporter.body: A reporter heard someone is restoring the abandoned club and wants to write a story.
en.events.iw_reporter.options.A: Give him a two-hour tour and lunch
en.events.iw_sponsor.title: The bank's banner
en.events.iw_sponsor.body: A local bank has seen the club come back to life and wants to hang banners all along the fence. The offer is good.
en.events.iw_dale_story.title: The last tournament
en.events.iw_dale_story.body: The night the pool is filled, Dale sits by the water and talks about the last tournament before the club closed. He was in the umpire's chair that year.
en.events.iw_dale_story.options.B: Take a few days off first
en.events.iw_dale_nudge.title: "We've been standing around"
en.events.iw_dale_nudge.body: Dale finds you by the clubhouse. "Two of us, a whole club, and we've been standing around for a day. There's still work we can start. Want me to take the next repair?"
en.events.iw_dale_nudge.options.A: Dale takes the next repair (materials paid when he starts)
en.events.iw_dale_sweep.title: "Want me to go fix it up?"
en.events.iw_dale_sweep.body: Dale comes in with sand on his boots. "One of our places is under 30 and going fast. Leave it and it drops a grade on Sunday. I can drop what I'm doing and spend three hours on it."
en.events.iw_dale_sweep.options.A: Dale goes (off his post for 3 hours)
en.events.iw_credit_union.title: The credit union calls
en.events.iw_credit_union.body: A loan officer from the Coachella Valley Credit Union stops at the gate. "Quiet week? We can float you $2500 now. Four weeks, $3000 back." If you don't pay it all then, they take $2000 (never below −$1000) and the town hears about it: reputation −4 or worse.
en.events.iw_loan_due.title: The loan is due
en.events.iw_loan_due.body: The credit union is back for its $3000. Pay it all, or pay $2000 and let the town talk about the rest.
en.events.iw_loan_due.options.B: Pay $2000 and owe them the rest (never below −$1000); reputation −4 or more
en.events.iw_rival_club.title: A challenge from La Quinta
en.events.iw_rival_club.body: The head coach of the La Quinta Racquet Club turns up at the clay courts. "Your members keep telling mine this place is back. Prove it. Club match, this weekend."
en.events.iw_rival_club.options.A: Take the challenge and host it
en.events.iw_dale_ten_years.title: Ten years
en.events.iw_dale_ten_years.body: A quiet week. Dale calls you into his office behind the clubhouse. "You never asked why I stayed. Ten years, alone with the sand." He pulls out a second chair.
en.events.iw_dale_ten_years.options.B: Another time, there's work to do
en.events.iw_hiring_day_1.title: The first hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_1.body: You put a notice on the clubhouse door and two people came. Anyone you hire is paid weekly.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_2.title: The second hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_2.body: Two weeks later two more came: a coach and a man who has worked on courts half his life.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_2b.title: The second hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_2b.body: Two weeks later two more came: a fitness coach and a college player who wants one more shot.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_3.title: The third hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_3.body: The garden has a bit of a name now, and the applicants are better: an injured former prodigy and a veteran coach.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_3b.title: The third hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_3b.body: The garden has a bit of a name now: someone who has strung racquets on tour, and a front-desk pro.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_4.title: The fourth hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_4.body: A former pro heard about the place and wants to be head coach; a young local all-rounder came too.
en.events.iw_hiring_day_4b.title: The fourth hiring day
en.events.iw_hiring_day_4b.body: The old grounds chief heard the club is coming back and turned up himself; so did a local kid who used to be a ball kid.
en.events.iw_route_s2.title: Which way does the club grow?
en.events.iw_route_s2.body: The clubhouse is open and Dale stands at the gate with the old brochure. "Families with kids, or hotel guests from Palm Springs? We can't chase both at once." If you don't choose by tomorrow, Dale picks the academy.
en.events.iw_route_s2.options.A: Youth: the academy and physio room open first; more coaches apply; academy lessons earn more
en.events.iw_route_s2.options.B: Resort: the café and resort pool open first; more service and fitness staff apply; busier weekends
en.events.iw_route_s3.title: Hal Brooks offers the golf strip
en.events.iw_route_s3.body: Hal Brooks, who owns the dead golf course next door, will give up its west strip. "Pave it for courts, or keep the pond and put up cabins. Your call." The survey costs $300 either way. If you don't choose by tomorrow, Dale picks the courts.
en.events.iw_route_s3.options.A: South courts: two new courts on the golf strip (now: weekend games there, members +4)
en.events.iw_route_s3.options.B: Oasis lawn: keep the pond, cabins and a small pool court (now: picnic lawn, reputation +3)
en.events.iw_route_s4.title: Where does the island grow?
en.events.iw_route_s4.body: A resort club needs room. Turn the south car park into a viewing slope and grow new land in the southeast, or bridge over to the little sky island with the two old net posts? If you don't choose by tomorrow, Dale picks the plaza.
en.events.iw_route_s4.options.A: Event plaza: a viewing slope for big matches (now: exhibition +5%)
en.events.iw_route_s4.options.B: Academy isle: a bridge to the island academy (now: academy lessons +$2, junior semifinal +10%)

en.bios.rosa_ortiz: Grew up beside the date groves in Coachella and kept La Quinta golf greens alive for twelve years; she always knows when the sand is coming.
en.bios.ben_kim: A UC Riverside student who works at a Palm Desert coffee shop and remembers every regular's order; sharpest in the morning.
en.bios.jess_park: Four years on a small-college team, then teaching kids in Palm Desert; she has always wanted courts of her own.
en.bios.gus_moreno: He laid these hard courts himself before the club closed; since the layoffs he hasn't set foot on a tennis court.
en.bios.kofi_mensah: Raised in Accra, eight years as strength coach for a college track team; always there before sunrise.
en.bios.amara_okafor: Born in Lagos, came to the US on a tennis scholarship and played four years of college matches; ranked outside the top 500, she wants one more shot.
en.bios.lily_chen: Grew up in her parents' restaurant in Palm Springs, then ran a resort hotel's front desk; the busier the evening, the better she gets.
en.bios.walt_hendricks: Thirty years teaching winter visitors at a Rancho Mirage country club; the skill is still there, the spark less so.
en.bios.teo_ilic: From Novi Sad; she has strung forty racquets a day in tour stringing rooms, and no racquet leaves her bench until the strings are straight.
en.bios.luca_ferreira: Top 20 in the junior rankings at sixteen, injured and burnt out at nineteen; at twenty-three he wants to like tennis again.
en.bios.nadia_volkov: A former tour pro who retired after shoulder surgery; her name still sells tickets.
en.bios.marco_ruiz: Grew up in Indio and works night shifts on the festival stage crews every spring; he has done a bit of everything.
en.bios.ray_delgado: Ran the grounds crew here when the big tournament came in the nineties and retired in Indian Wells; he remembers every pipe, but his knees don't keep up.
en.bios.mateo_salgado: Sixteen, from Coachella, a ball kid at the big tournament two years running; he bikes over straight after school.

zh.endings.exhibition.title: 表演赛办成了
zh.endings.exhibition.body: 十年来第一次，中心球场的看台上坐满了人。Palm Oasis 又活过来了。
zh.endings.deadline.title: 期限到了
zh.endings.deadline.body: 投资方给的十六周到了，表演赛还没办成。修复停了，大门又锁上了。
zh.endings.bankrupt.title: 钱花光了
zh.endings.bankrupt.body: 俱乐部发不出工资，投资方叫停了修复。大门又锁上了。
zh.events.iw_pickle_noise.title: 太吵了，还少了一片场
zh.events.iw_pickle_noise.body: 三位在这儿打了二十年网球的老会员在匹克球场边等你："啪、啪、啪，一整个周末。为了这个还拆了一片网球场。"有几个人已经在说去 La Quinta 了。
zh.events.iw_pickle_noise.options.B: 开个会员会，讲清楚分时段（你亲自去 3 小时，不一定谈得拢）
zh.events.iw_investor_check.title: 投资方来看进度
zh.events.iw_investor_check.body: 投资方的人站在大门口。离他们给的期限只剩三周了。
zh.events.iw_deadline.title: 期限到了
zh.events.iw_deadline.body: 十六周到了。投资方的人把一份文件放在会所的桌子上。
zh.events.iw_arrival.title: 仓库里的发球机
zh.events.iw_arrival.body: Dale 带你转了一圈。"十年了，没人在这儿打过一个球。"仓库角落里还有一台旧发球机。
zh.events.iw_arrival.options.A: 留着，以后修好给学院用
zh.events.iw_first_players.title: 第一批客人
zh.events.iw_first_players.body: 两位从 Palm Desert 来的退休老人站在会员场门口，问能不能打一场。
zh.events.iw_sandstorm.title: 起风了
zh.events.iw_sandstorm.body: 风卷着沙往球场里灌，Dale 在对讲机里喊：要不要现在去把场地盖上？
zh.events.iw_reporter.title: The Desert Sun 来了
zh.events.iw_reporter.body: 一位记者听说有人在修这座废弃的俱乐部，想来写一篇报道。
zh.events.iw_reporter.options.A: 亲自带他转两个小时，请他吃午饭
zh.events.iw_sponsor.title: 银行的横幅
zh.events.iw_sponsor.body: 本地一家银行看到俱乐部又热闹起来，想在围网上挂一圈横幅，出价不低。
zh.events.iw_dale_story.title: 最后一届比赛
zh.events.iw_dale_story.body: 泳池放满水的那天晚上，Dale 坐在池边说起俱乐部关门前的最后一届比赛，他那年坐在裁判椅上。
zh.events.iw_dale_story.options.A: 表演赛那天请你坐裁判椅
zh.events.iw_dale_nudge.title: “咱俩站了一天了”
zh.events.iw_dale_nudge.body: Dale 在会所门口找到你："两个人，一整座俱乐部，咱俩干站了一天了。还有能动手的活。下一件修复交给我？"
zh.events.iw_dale_nudge.options.A: 交给 Dale 去干下一件修复（开工时扣材料费）
zh.events.iw_dale_sweep.title: “我去收拾一下？”
zh.events.iw_dale_sweep.body: Dale 进门时鞋上全是沙："有一处掉到 30 以下了，掉得很快。不管它，周日就要掉一档。我可以放下手上的事，去收拾三个小时。"
zh.events.iw_credit_union.title: 信用社来电
zh.events.iw_credit_union.body: Coachella Valley 信用社的信贷员停在大门口："这礼拜挺清闲？我们现在可以先借你 $2500，四周后还 $3000。"到时候不还全额，就先扣 $2000（最多扣到 −$1000），镇上也会传开：声望 −4 起。
zh.events.iw_loan_due.title: 贷款到期
zh.events.iw_loan_due.body: 信用社来收那 $3000 了。一次还清，还是先还 $2000、剩下的让镇上去议论？
zh.events.iw_loan_due.options.B: 先还 $2000、剩下的欠着（最多扣到 −$1000），声望 −4 起
zh.events.iw_rival_club.title: La Quinta 来下战书
zh.events.iw_rival_club.body: La Quinta 网球俱乐部的主教练来到红土场："你们的会员老跟我的会员说这儿又活过来了。那就比一场，这个周末，俱乐部对抗赛。"
zh.events.iw_dale_ten_years.title: 十年
zh.events.iw_dale_ten_years.body: 清闲的一个礼拜，Dale 把你叫进会所后面的办公室："你从来没问过我为什么留下来。十年，一个人守着这片沙子。"他拉出第二把椅子。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_1.title: 第一个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_1.body: 会所门口贴了告示，来了两个人。招了就每周付工资。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_2.title: 第二个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_2.body: 两周后又来了两个人：一位教练，一个干了半辈子的场地工。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_2b.title: 第二个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_2b.body: 两周后又来了两个人：一个体能师，一个大学打完还想再拼一次的球员。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_3.title: 第三个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_3.body: 俱乐部有点名气了，来的人水平也高了：一个受过伤的天才少年，一位老教练。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_3b.title: 第三个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_3b.body: 俱乐部有点名气了：一个在巡回赛上穿过线的人，一个前台好手。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_4.title: 第四个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_4.body: 一位前职业球员听说了这里，想来当主教练；还有一个什么都会一点的本地年轻人。
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_4b.title: 第四个招聘日
zh.events.iw_hiring_day_4b.body: 当年的场地主管听说俱乐部要活过来，自己找上门；还有一个当过球童的本地孩子。
zh.events.iw_route_s2.title: 俱乐部往哪边走？
zh.events.iw_route_s2.body: 会所开张了，Dale 拿着那本旧宣传册站在大门口："带孩子的家庭，还是 Palm Springs 酒店来的客人？两头一起追不过来。"明天还不定，Dale 就按青训来。
zh.events.iw_route_s2.options.A: 青训之路：学院、理疗室先开；来应聘的教练多；学院课多挣一点
zh.events.iw_route_s2.options.B: 度假之路：咖啡吧、度假泳池先开；来应聘的服务、体能人员多；周末客人多
zh.events.iw_route_s3.title: Hal Brooks 让出高尔夫西段
zh.events.iw_route_s3.body: 隔壁荒掉的高尔夫球场老板 Hal Brooks 愿意让出西段："铺成球场，还是留着水塘盖小屋，你定。"两边都要付 $300 测量费。明天还不定，Dale 就按南场来。
zh.events.iw_route_s3.options.A: 南场：在高尔夫西段铺两片新场（现在：先在那儿办周末对打，会员 +4）
zh.events.iw_route_s3.options.B: 绿洲草坪：留下水塘，盖小屋和小泳池庭院（现在：水塘边先收拾成野餐地，声望 +3）
zh.events.iw_route_s4.title: 岛往哪边长？
zh.events.iw_route_s4.body: 度假名园要地方。把南停车场改成观赛坡、在东南角长出新地，还是搭一座桥，把东南天上那座带两根旧网柱的小岛接过来？明天还不定，Dale 就按赛事广场来。
zh.events.iw_route_s4.options.A: 赛事广场：大比赛的观赛坡（现在：表演赛成功率 +5%）
zh.events.iw_route_s4.options.B: 学院岛：搭桥接上岛上的学院（现在：学院课每圈 +$2，青少年赛进四强 +10%）

zh.bios.rosa_ortiz: 在 Coachella 的椰枣园边长大，给 La Quinta 的高尔夫球场修了十二年草坪；风沙要来，她总是先知道。
zh.bios.ben_kim: UC Riverside 的学生，在 Palm Desert 的咖啡店打工，记得每个熟客点什么；早上精神最好。
zh.bios.jess_park: 在一所小大学打了四年校队，毕业后在 Palm Desert 教孩子打球，一直想有一块自己的场地。
zh.bios.gus_moreno: 俱乐部关门前，这里的硬地是他一块块铺的；裁员那天以后，他再没进过网球场。
zh.bios.kofi_mensah: 在 Accra 长大，给一所大学的田径队当了八年体能教练，天亮之前就到场。
zh.bios.amara_okafor: 生在 Lagos，拿网球奖学金来美国打了四年大学比赛；排名在五百开外，想再拼一次。
zh.bios.lily_chen: 在父母开在 Palm Springs 的餐馆里长大，后来在度假酒店管前台；晚上客人越多，她越来劲。
zh.bios.walt_hendricks: 在 Rancho Mirage 的乡村俱乐部教了三十年过冬的退休客人；手艺还在，心有点累了。
zh.bios.teo_ilic: 从 Novi Sad 来，在巡回赛的穿线房里一天穿过四十支拍子；线不直，她不交拍。
zh.bios.luca_ferreira: 十六岁进过青少年排名前二十，十九岁手腕伤了、也打怕了；现在二十三岁，想重新喜欢上网球。
zh.bios.nadia_volkov: 前职业球员，肩伤动过手术以后退役；她的名字还能卖出票。
zh.bios.marco_ruiz: 在 Indio 长大，每年春天在音乐节的搭台队上夜班，什么活都干过一点。
zh.bios.ray_delgado: 九十年代这里办大赛时的场地主管，退休后就住在 Indian Wells；俱乐部的每根水管他都记得，膝盖却不行了。
zh.bios.mateo_salgado: 十六岁，Coachella 人，前两年在大赛上当过球童；一放学就骑车过来。
